item.text: {"tool":"read_evidence","argument":"music-benchmark","why":"Read the domain-specific format audit before choosing an experiment targeting the enlarged Audiveris baseline’s 66.9% melody error and 30 missing pilot chords.","hypothesis":"The audit may identify whether omitted chord symbols remain available as OCR text and whether symbolic-format failures contribute to melody errors.","expected_observation":"Evidence about recoverable chord text and notation conversion limitations; absent or corrupted OCR chord text would weaken the case for text-to-harmony extraction.","evidence_ids":["dataset","baseline","source-catalog"]}
